"""Source code is embedded in each exported flow, including its imports."""

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import MultilineInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame


class ScienceFixtureBundle(Component):
    display_name = "合成样例数据包"
    description = "读取流程内嵌的人工表格、文本和文件，核对 SHA-256 后写入本次运行的临时目录。"
    name = "ScienceFixtureBundle"
    icon = "FlaskConical"
    inputs = [MultilineInput(name="bundle_base64", display_name="内嵌合成样例（Base64 JSON）", value="e30=")]
    outputs = [
        Output(name="table", display_name="样例表格", method="build_table", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="data", display_name="文件与证据", method="build_data", group_outputs=True),
    ]

    def build_table(self) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(json.loads(base64.b64decode(self.bundle_base64, validate=True)).get("records", []))

    def build_data(self) -> Data:
        bundle = json.loads(base64.b64decode(self.bundle_base64, validate=True))
        root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="studyui-science-"))
        outputs = root / "results"
        outputs.mkdir()
        paths = {"output": str(outputs)}
        for name, blob in bundle.get("assets", {}).items():
            if Path(name).name != name or name in {"", ".", "..", "output", "results"}:
                raise ValueError("Asset names must be simple unique filenames")
            raw = base64.b64decode(blob["base64"], validate=True)
            if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != blob["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError(f"Embedded asset checksum mismatch: {name}")
            path = root / name
            path.write_bytes(raw)
            paths[name] = str(path)
        return Data(data={**bundle.get("data", {}), "asset_paths": paths, "synthetic": True})

"""Native window and unit controls for electrical curve analysis."""

from copy import deepcopy

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import DataFrameInput, DropdownInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame, Message

from materials_quality.batch.native import native_frame, prepare_form
from materials_quality.common import json_value
from materials_quality.context import table_fingerprint
from materials_quality.science.electrical import OPERATION, PHOTO_TIMES, analyze_electrical
from materials_quality.science.table_contract import contract_identity, read_contract


class ElectricalAnalysis(Component):
    display_name = "材料批量·I–V 与光响应分析"
    description = "逐曲线拟合指定电压窗，或按显式光照时刻测量幅度与 10%–90% 响应时间。"
    name = "ElectricalAnalysis"
    icon = "Zap"

    inputs = [
        DataFrameInput(name="input_table", display_name="完整测量点表（按采集顺序）", required=True),
        DropdownInput(
            name="mode",
            display_name="分析方式",
            options=["iv", "photoresponse"],
            value="iv",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="curve_id",
            display_name="曲线 ID 列",
            options=["curve_id"],
            value="curve_id",
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sample_id",
            display_name="试样 ID 列（可选）",
            options=["", "sample_id"],
            value="",
            combobox=True,
            info="留空时沿用上游明确声明的试样列。",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="current",
            display_name="电流列",
            options=["current"],
            value="current",
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="current_unit",
            display_name="电流单位（必须声明）",
            options=["A", "mA", "uA", "nA", "pA"],
            value="",
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="voltage",
            display_name="电压列",
            options=["voltage"],
            value="voltage",
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="voltage_unit",
            display_name="电压单位（必须声明）",
            options=["V", "mV", "uV"],
            value="",
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sweep",
            display_name="扫描分支列（可选）",
            options=["", "sweep"],
            value="",
            combobox=True,
            info="每个分支的电压须严格单调。往返扫描须提供分支标签。",
        ),
        StrInput(name="voltage_min", display_name="拟合电压下限（含端点）", value=""),
        StrInput(name="voltage_max", display_name="拟合电压上限（含端点）", value=""),
        DropdownInput(
            name="time",
            display_name="时间列",
            options=["time"],
            value="time",
            combobox=True,
            show=False,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="time_unit",
            display_name="时间单位（必须声明）",
            options=["ms", "s", "min", "h"],
            value="",
            combobox=True,
            show=False,
        ),
        StrInput(name="baseline_start", display_name="暗态基线窗口开始", value="", show=False),
        StrInput(name="baseline_end", display_name="暗态基线窗口结束", value="", show=False),
        StrInput(name="light_on", display_name="开光时刻", value="", show=False),
        StrInput(name="on_plateau_start", display_name="亮态平台窗口开始", value="", show=False),
        StrInput(name="on_plateau_end", display_name="亮态平台窗口结束", value="", show=False),
        StrInput(name="light_off", display_name="关光时刻", value="", show=False),
        StrInput(name="recovery_end", display_name="恢复搜索窗口结束", value="", show=False),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(name=name, display_name=label, method=f"build_{name}", group_outputs=True, cache=False)
        for name, label in (
            ("features", "逐曲线特征与状态"),
            ("curves", "原始测量与派生曲线"),
            ("report", "分析报告与追溯"),
            ("summary", "运行摘要"),
        )
    ]

    def to_frontend_node(self, *args, **kwargs):
        node = super().to_frontend_node(*args, **kwargs)
        self.update_build_config(node["data"]["node"]["template"], self.mode, "mode")
        return prepare_form(node)

    def update_build_config(self, build_config, field_value, field_name=None):
        if field_name == "mode":
            build_config["mode"]["value"] = field_value
        iv = build_config["mode"]["value"] == "iv"
        for key in ("voltage", "voltage_unit", "sweep", "voltage_min", "voltage_max"):
            build_config[key]["show"] = iv
        for key in ("time", "time_unit", *PHOTO_TIMES):
            build_config[key]["show"] = not iv
        frame = field_value if field_name == "input_table" else getattr(self, "input_table", None)
        if hasattr(frame, "columns"):
            columns = list(frame.columns)
            for key in ("curve_id", "sample_id", "current", "voltage", "sweep", "time"):
                field = build_config[key]
                field["options"] = list(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        [
                            *([""] if key in {"sample_id", "sweep"} else []),
                            *columns,
                            *([field["value"]] if field["value"] else []),
                        ]
                    )
                )
        return build_config

    def _config(self):
        iv = self.mode == "iv"
        mode_fields = ("voltage", "voltage_unit", "sweep") if iv else ("time", "time_unit")
        fields = ("mode", "curve_id", "sample_id", "current", "current_unit", *mode_fields)
        config = {key: getattr(self, key) for key in fields}
        for key in ("voltage_min", "voltage_max") if iv else PHOTO_TIMES:
            value = getattr(self, key)
            try:
                config[key] = float(value)
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"{key} requires an explicit numeric coordinate") from exc
        return config

    def _result(self):
        config = self._config()
        signature = (table_fingerprint(self.input_table), contract_identity(self.input_table), config)
        cached = self._ctx.get(OPERATION)
        if cached is None or cached[0] != signature:
            cached = (signature, analyze_electrical(self.input_table, config))
            self._ctx[OPERATION] = cached
        return cached

    def build_features(self) -> DataFrame:
        return native_frame(self._result()[1].features)

    def build_curves(self) -> DataFrame:
        return native_frame(self._result()[1].table)

    def build_report(self) -> Data:
        (table_hash, contract_hash, config), result = self._result()
        return Data(
            data={
                "schema_version": "science-result/1",
                "operation": OPERATION,
                "data": deepcopy(result.data),
                "warnings": list(result.warnings),
                "artifacts": [],
                "table_contract": read_contract(result.table),
                "table_fingerprint": table_fingerprint(result.table),
                "features_contract": read_contract(result.features),
                "features_fingerprint": table_fingerprint(result.features),
                "features_preview": json_value(
                    {
                        "total_rows": len(result.features),
                        "records": result.features.head(20).to_dict("records"),
                        "units": result.features.attrs["units"],
                    }
                ),
                "provenance": {
                    "input_table_fingerprint": table_hash,
                    "input_contract_sha256": contract_hash,
                    "parameters": deepcopy(config),
                    "raw_preserved": True,
                },
            }
        )

    def build_summary(self) -> Message:
        result = self._result()[1].data
        counts = result["status_counts"]
        return Message(
            text=(
                f"分析 {result['curve_count']} 个曲线或扫描分支。完整 {counts.get('ok', 0)}，"
                f"部分 {counts.get('partial', 0)}，无效 {counts.get('invalid', 0)}。"
            )
        )

"""Plan preview and scientific metadata confirmation through native forms."""

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import Output
from lfx.schema import Data, Message

from materials_quality.batch.native import prepare_form
from materials_quality.skills.native import (
    COLUMNS,
    THRESHOLD_MODES,
    UNIT_MODES,
    VISIBLE,
    parameters_from,
    planner_inputs,
)
from materials_quality.skills.planning import _route, input_identity, make_plan
from materials_quality.skills.registry import digest, list_skills, load_skill


class ResearchSkillPlanner(Component):
    display_name = "科研技能·任务规划"
    description = "选择光谱、力学或组间研究；原生表单确认参数，先预览步骤与待补事项，再连接执行。"
    name = "ResearchSkillPlanner"
    icon = "ClipboardList"
    inputs = planner_inputs()
    outputs = [
        Output(
            name="plan", display_name="经校验的分析计划", method="build_plan", group_outputs=True, cache=False
        ),
        Output(
            name="preview",
            display_name="步骤与待补事项",
            method="build_preview",
            group_outputs=True,
            cache=False,
        ),
    ]

    def _plan(self):
        task = _route(self.request) if self.task == "auto" else self.task
        p = parameters_from(self, task)
        signature = digest(
            [input_identity(self.input_table), self.task, self.request, p, self.use_model, list_skills()]
        )
        cached = self._ctx.get("research_plan")
        if cached is None or cached[0] != signature:
            if self.use_model:
                from materials_quality.skills.model import suggest_plan

                plan = suggest_plan(self.input_table, self.request, task=self.task, parameters=p)
            else:
                plan = make_plan(self.input_table, task=self.task, request=self.request, parameters=p)
            self._ctx["research_plan"] = (signature, plan)
        return self._ctx["research_plan"][1]

    def build_plan(self) -> Data:
        from copy import deepcopy

        return Data(data=deepcopy(self._plan()))

    def build_preview(self) -> Message:
        p = self._plan()
        lines = [
            "计划可执行。" if p["ready"] else "需要补充信息，尚未执行计算。",
            f"输入 {p['input']['rows']} 行、{len(p['input']['columns'])} 列；"
            f"任务：{load_skill(p['task'])['title'] if p['task'] else '待选择'}。",
        ]
        lines.extend(f"{i + 1}. {step}" for i, step in enumerate(p["steps"]))
        lines.extend(f"待补：{item['message']}" for item in p["issues"])
        labels = {
            "curve_id": "曲线编号",
            "x": "波长列",
            "y": "强度列",
            "group": "组别",
            "sample_id": "样品编号",
            "strain": "应变列",
            "stress": "应力列",
            "experimental_unit": "独立试验单位",
            "peak_window": "候选窗口（nm）",
            "fit_range": "弹性拟合区间",
            "x_unit": "波长单位",
            "y_unit": "强度单位",
            "strain_unit": "应变单位",
            "stress_unit": "应力单位",
            "value_unit": "测量值单位",
            "selection_rule": "候选选择规则",
            "prominence_mode": "阈值来源",
            "unit_mode": "统计单位方式",
            "small_sample_policy": "小样本政策",
        }
        lines.extend(f"{labels[k]}：{v}" for k, v in p["parameters"].items() if k in labels and v is not None)
        lines.extend("提示：" + w for w in p["warnings"])
        return Message(text="\n".join(lines))

    def update_build_config(self, build_config, field_value, field_name=None):
        if field_name in build_config:
            build_config[field_name]["value"] = field_value
        task = build_config["task"].get("value", self.task)
        request = build_config["request"].get("value", self.request)
        task = _route(request) if task == "auto" else task
        # No inferred task: display task selector and request, rather than all task fields.
        allowed = VISIBLE.get(task, set())
        for name in set().union(*VISIBLE.values()):
            build_config[name]["show"] = name in allowed
        if task == "mechanics":
            build_config["x_column"]["display_name"] = "应变列"
            build_config["y_column"]["display_name"] = "应力列"
        else:
            build_config["x_column"]["display_name"] = "波长列"
            build_config["y_column"]["display_name"] = "强度列"
        if task == "spectra":
            for name in ("smooth_window", "smooth_order"):
                build_config[name]["show"] = bool(build_config["smooth"].get("value", self.smooth))
            build_config["baseline_value"]["show"] = build_config["baseline"].get("value") == "constant"
            threshold = THRESHOLD_MODES.get(
                build_config["prominence_mode"].get("value"), build_config["prominence_mode"].get("value")
            )
            build_config["prominence"]["show"] = threshold == "absolute"
            for name in ("noise_confirmed", "noise_low", "noise_high", "noise_multiplier"):
                build_config[name]["show"] = threshold == "noise_reference"
            build_config["peak_distance_x"]["show"] = bool(build_config["distance_enabled"].get("value"))
            unit = UNIT_MODES.get(
                build_config["unit_mode"].get("value"), build_config["unit_mode"].get("value")
            )
            build_config["unit_column"]["show"] = unit == "sample"
            build_config["unit_confirmed"]["show"] = unit != "descriptive"
        if field_name == "input_table" and hasattr(field_value, "columns"):
            for name in COLUMNS:
                build_config[name]["options"] = ["", *field_value.columns.tolist()]
        return build_config

    def to_frontend_node(self, *args, **kwargs):
        result = super().to_frontend_node(*args, **kwargs)
        result["data"]["node"]["field_order"] = [field.name for field in self.inputs]
        self.update_build_config(result["data"]["node"]["template"], None)
        return prepare_form(result)
